calendar_note: All scenario time is relative to D0 (landfall). Change d0_date to remap every output; nothing else stores calendar dates.

id_formats.story: NWS-M045-01 for day -45; NWS-P000-03 for day 0; NWS-P112-02 for day 112 (M = minus, P = zero or plus)

realism_rules: Real: places, counties, military installations, ports, infrastructure, government agencies.
Fictional: people, companies, news outlets, ship and aircraft identities, the storm, the foreign sponsor (never named).
Never name or quote real elected officials or agency heads; quotes come from fictional spokespeople, residents, workers and experts in characters.json.
Misconduct belongs only to fictional companies, people and the unnamed foreign state.
Counts, dollar amounts and damage are scenario values, not real statistics.

public_exclusions.note: Places never shown in public outputs, and phrases that must never appear in them. Read by build_graph, build_release and check_acceptance for every registered scenario.
